maya (eng-runtime): Heads-up — after the kernel-selector flip at 17:30 we've got a clear p95 regression on host-side requests. p50 looks fine but p95 jumped a lot. :eyes:

trevor (eng-runtime): ugh, saw an alert. How big of a jump?

maya (eng-runtime): p95: ~42ms -> ~128ms for short text requests (seq len < 64). p99 also up. Throughput unchanged.

zoe (perf): I grabbed a CPU profile from one affected host. Short summary: tokenize()/parse path dominates now. Kernel selection change added extra per-request pathing that causes tokenizer pool thrash.

alex (infra): any flamegraphs or pprof links?

zoe (perf): link: https://pprof.internal/host/1788/tokenize-flame (internal)

zoe (perf): snippet from pprof top:
```
37.2%  tokenize_worker
12.9%  grpc_writev
9.8%   kernel_selector::choose_path
8.7%   ssl_stream_write
```

maya (eng-runtime): interesting — kernel_selector is only 9.8% but tokenize is huge. My hunch: kernel-selector change revalidated model metadata per-request which forces tokenizer allocation / reset.

trevor (eng-runtime): i ran perf on a repro host and saw a lot of short-lived allocations in tokenizer arena. Also observed more small writev syscalls (grpc framing) because streaming frames are not being coalesced.

alex (infra): got tcpdump/strace. grpc write pattern looks like many small frames instead of 1 larger frame. This increases syscall overhead.

maya (eng-runtime): exact repro command I used:
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --script=short_text.lua http://host:8080/generate
```

zoe (perf): latency histogram (before -> after):
```
p50: 18ms -> 19ms
p90: 36ms -> 45ms
p95: 42ms -> 128ms
p99: 78ms -> 210ms
```

trevor (eng-runtime): root cause candidates:
- tokenizer pool gets torn down / recreated per-request due to metadata revalidation
- kernel selector path does an extra sync causing scheduling jitter
- streaming frame coalescing logic got bypassed for certain fast-paths

maya (eng-runtime): I instrumented the request path and found this sequence: kernel_selector -> validate_model_variant() -> clear_tokenizer_ctx() -> allocate_tokenizer() -> tokenize. If validate_model_variant() returns 'changed' we rebuild; even when identical it re-enters the rebuild path due to cache key mismatch.

zoe (perf): cache key mismatch is likely from a new field in model metadata that we started including (fp16_capability) — that change made the key unstable.

alex (infra): quick mitigation: we can gate the kernel-selector rollout to not touch the validate path, or short-term revert. Which is faster?

trevor (eng-runtime): revert is fastest for immediate remediation. But we should also patch tokenizer pool reuse so it survives validate path.

maya (eng-runtime): agree. rollback + hotfix. I can prepare a small change to avoid clearing tokenizer when variant metadata hash unchanged.

zoe (perf): I can validate hotfix by running wrk and collecting pprof; aim to get p95 back under 60ms before full rollout.

alex (infra): deploy-bot, can you start a rollback of kernel-selector feature-flag on the canary group?

deploy-bot: Rolling back feature flag kernel-selector on canary (hosts: canary-1..3). Started at 17:54. Status: in-progress.

maya (eng-runtime): i'll push the tokenizer-resize reuse patch to a branch and drop a PR. Small changes: avoid allocate_tokenizer() if ctx->hash == prev_hash and dont_reset_pool flag set.

trevor (eng-runtime): code sketch in the PR comment (very small):
```
if (ctx->meta_hash == host->cached_meta_hash) {
  // keep pool
  gc_mode = KEEP
} else {
  rebuild_tokenizer_pool()
}
```

zoe (perf): after rollback started, i'm seeing p95 trend back down on canary hosts. will post numbers in 5m.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed on canary group. All canaries passing health checks.

maya (eng-runtime): can confirm canary p95 now ~46ms. Planning: hold full rollout until hotfix merged and validated.

trevor (eng-runtime): follow-up actions:
- short-term: rollback rollout (done)
- medium: merge tokenizer pool reuse hotfix + unit test for metadata-hash stability
- long-term: add an e2e perf test for kernel-selector changes (wrk + pprof baseline)

zoe (perf): i'll add a perf-regression CI job that runs the short_text scenario and fails if p95 increases >20%.

alex (infra): thanks team. moving to block rollout until green. :thumbsup:

maya (eng-runtime): +1 — i'll update the release notes and post a short blurb in #release-war-room.

trevor (eng-runtime): great. tagging this thread for postmortem later.

maya (eng-runtime): thanks all.
